guest-words.keyboard.message: Keyboard layout from the emulator's machine settings
guest-words.keyboard.note: Inside the guest: the description of the systemd unit (webpc-keyboard.service) that sets the guest's keyboard layout from the machine's settings, as `systemctl status` and the boot log show it. One line, no trailing period.

guest-words.network.message: Network configuration from the emulator's machine settings
guest-words.network.note: Inside the guest: the description of the systemd unit (webpc-network.service) that applies the network settings the page gives the guest's adapters, as `systemctl status` and the boot log show it. One line, no trailing period.

guest-words.shares.note: Inside the guest: the description of the mount and automount units of the shared folders (e.g. mnt-webpc.mount), as `systemctl status`, `mount` tools and the boot log show it. One line, no trailing period.

guest-words.agent.note: Inside the guest: the description of the systemd unit (webpc-agent.service) that runs the small program of the emulator's that shares the clipboard between the guest and the web app, as `systemctl status` and the boot log show it. One line, no trailing period.
